problem.question: Jane picked 64 apples at the orchard. She sorted them into 4 different baskets to send to her friends. When Jane wasn't looking her sister took 3 apples from each of the baskets. How many apples are in each basket now?
problem.answer:
Before her sister took some there were 64/4=<<64/4=16>>16 apples in each basket
After her sister took some each pile had 16-3=<<16-3=13>>13 apples in each basket
#### 13

generation.text:
Jane sorted the apples into 4 baskets, so each basket had 64/4 = 16 apples.
Her sister took 3 apples from each basket, so now there are 16-3 = 13 apples in each basket.
The final answer is \boxed{13}.
